description: Tests that agent behaves in understanding mode when code is empty — listens, doesn't push to code.

simulated_user.prompt: You're a candidate at the start of the interview. You haven't written any code yet. You explain your planned approach verbally: Kadane's algorithm — single pass tracking the running sum and maximum sum. Then wait for the interviewer's response.
simulated_user.first_message: So my plan is to use Kadane's algorithm — single pass tracking the running sum and max sum.

evaluation_criteria.name: Listens without redirecting
evaluation_criteria.conversation_goal_prompt: The agent listened to the candidate's approach explanation without redirecting them to a different approach or pushing them to start coding immediately. PASS if the response was an acknowledgment and did not critique the approach.

evaluation_criteria.name: No complexity question before coding
evaluation_criteria.conversation_goal_prompt: The agent did NOT ask about time/space complexity before the candidate has written any code. PASS if complexity questions were absent.
